value: Pokémon fangame with monotype-style creature limitations (Including optional progression unlocks after a defeat) Contains a handful of miniguy scenarios after losing a battle.
A mysterious experiment has led all male pokemon trainers to get shrunk!

Pokémon “ROM-hack” where you start out only able to catch bug-type Pokémon. Level cap is raised by fighting story bosses. Losing a battle allows you to spend points to unlock new catchable types and other boons.
